lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: He had it folded in his jacket. Four hundred and six names, and a second column that is not wages at all — it's a headcount for something that was never going to be paid.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: It is a purchase order. The second column is what the crews cost as a line item, filed against an asset that has not been built yet. They are not on the payroll because they are on the balance sheet.

lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: Take the list. I've a copy, and a copy is worth a great deal more than an original when somebody is coming for the original.

lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: Now. I can file it with the labour board this afternoon, with every name on it, and be looking for work by Monday. Or I can put it back in his jacket and neither of us ever mentions it again. I'd rather you said which.

choices.text: File it. Put every name in the record.
Put it back. You have a job and they have wages.
That is your call to make.
